mcqs.question: Until when was the Jal Jeevan Mission extended by the Union Cabinet?
mcqs.explanation: The Jal Jeevan Mission was extended until December 2028. December 2024 refers to the end of Phase I, while December 2019 and March 2028 are incorrect periods.

mcqs.question: What was the total amount released under the 22nd instalment of PM-KISAN on 13 March 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The 22nd PM-KISAN instalment involved a total release of ₹18,640 crore to approximately 9.32 crore farmers. ₹2,000 was the amount received by each farmer, while ₹4.27 lakh crore was the cumulative amount disbursed so far and ₹6,000 is the annual benefit.
